name: sandbox-runtime
notes: Forked from carderne/sandbox-runtime (itself derived from Anthropic's sandbox-runtime); local fork adds filesystem.protectNonexistentFiles so embedders can skip bwrap placeholder mounts for not-yet-existing dangerous files, and network.disabled so a session can run with all network policy enforcement off (no proxy/bridge started, no network rules emitted). Published locally as @xzzpig/sandbox-runtime; it is a support library for pi-sandbox rather than a Pi plugin, so the record keeps the plain upstream-derived name instead of the pi-* plugin convention. v0.0.72 sync adopted upstream's independent sandbox manager instances (#20), the sandbox-manager.ts proxy/lifecycle rework, the Windows srt-win installer and proxy-port-range work, and upstream's fail-closed 'reject sandbox commands when the network proxy is unavailable' guard (#19) — that guard changes one fork test (a per-call network block omitting disabled after a network.disabled session now throws instead of emitting a hard-blocked command); pi-sandbox passes no per-call network block, so its behavior is unchanged. Re-apply network.disabled, filesystem.protectNonexistentFiles, the readdirSync withFileTypes cast (sandbox-utils.ts), and the closeAllConnections cast (sandbox-manager.ts) on each future sync. 2026-09-19: pathEntryLstatExists exported (plus root re-export) for reuse by the pi-sandbox fork, whose duplicate pathEntryExists was removed; network.disabled precedence consolidated into fork-only src/sandbox/fork-network.ts isNetworkDisabled (two call sites in sandbox-manager.ts); protectNonexistentFiles tests moved from test/sandbox/mandatory-deny-paths.test.ts (byte-identical to upstream again) to fork-only test/sandbox/protect-nonexistent-files.test.ts. package-lock.json keeps upstream bytes with only the two name fields set to @xzzpig/sandbox-runtime (unconsumed by the pnpm monorepo); the exact typescript 5.6.3 pin is deliberate — do not widen without a build check.
